rawContent: I got woke up by this at around 1:30 am, in the Oxfordshire/Northants area. Did anyone else see the #thunderstorm ? #ClimateCrisis #HEATWAVE2019

The NHS needs more funding etc to improve asthma services. However, we need to look at other reasons why both asthma & fatalities are increasing. The #ClimateCrisis is not helping. Everywhere we go there are too many chemicals & there is still too much pollution from cars etc.
